{{Top|leg}}
The '''Crescent of Service''' was a type of award given by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for valorous deeds, though it was a lesser award than the [[Medal of Bravery/Legends|Medal of Bravery]].

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|For your actions on Corellia, General Var Suthra recommended you all receive the Crescent of Service. But you've earned more than that.|Satele Shan|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The Crescent of Service is mentioned in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' at the conclusion of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] storyline, but only if the player makes the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] alignment choices on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Otherwise, [[Var Suthra]] recommends the player for the Medal of Bravery.
